beats.text: Two old seals still hold something down, and a courier waits at a settlement for word of them.

search.text: Let me mark them for you...

found: The first seal lies under the {structure}, {distance} blocks to the {direction}.
Start with the {structure}: {distance} blocks {direction}. That's where the first seal sleeps.

text: {boss} nests there, {danger}. Bring friends, or a good will.
Fair warning: {boss} keeps the place, and it is {danger}.
{boss} holds it, {danger}. Doable, if you come prepared.
{boss} is in residence. {danger}, but every giant falls eventually.
{boss} lurks there, {danger}. A decent test of your gear.
It's guarded by {boss}, {danger}. Not much of a threat if you're careful.

found.text: I can't say what waits inside. That's part of the charm.

found: A second lies in another cold place, and Orin waits in a village to hear of it. Your map will show all three.
nothing: I cannot place them from here. Try again later.
accepted: Then go, and speak to Orin last. He'll know what to do with your word.
Go. Break them in any order, but speak to Orin last.

thanks.text: Orin's word reached me first. You have done more than I asked.
